purpose: Replace the flat placeholder relic icons with painted icons that match the starter relic. Exported to images/relics by art_sources/tools/export_relics.py.
style:
Relic icon for the roguelike card game Slay the Spire. Hand-painted game icon: a thick, bold, dark navy outline around the whole silhouette, cel shading with two or three tones, a few crisp highlights, light from the upper left. Chunky, compact proportions so the object stays readable when shrunk to 64 pixels: no thin spindly parts and no tiny details. Palette: deep blues and cyans with small gold, silver or warm wood accents. Match the finish and palette of the reference relic (a blue crystal in a silver frame); ignore the reference's flat green background.

Composition: a single object, centred, filling about 75% of the canvas, fully visible. Transparent background. No cast shadow, no text or letters, no frame or border, no scenery.

jobs.name: chant_primer
jobs.subject: a small lecture handout on beginner chanting: a thick, slightly worn booklet lying open, its corners curled up. On the page, a simple glowing blue magic rune built only from a small circle and three short straight strokes (an invented sigil, not a letter or symbol from any real writing system or religion), circled several times in blue ink. A short blue bookmark ribbon.

jobs.name: teaching_pointer
jobs.subject: a teacher's pointer, drawn short and thick: a stout tapered wooden rod with a large faceted blue crystal at its tip held by a silver band, and a navy ribbon bow near the handle. Shown diagonally from lower left to upper right.

jobs.name: hydraulic_seal
jobs.subject: a heavy round magic seal medallion of dark stone with a silver rim, its face carved with a rune where water is compressed into a tight, glowing blue spiral, as if mana is being pressed back into the spell.

jobs.name: travel_flask
jobs.subject: a sturdy traveller's potion flask with a rounded glass body, a cork stopper, a short leather strap and a brass collar, half filled with glowing blue liquid.

jobs.name: mana_crystal_core
jobs.relic: RoxyManaCrystalCore 洛琪希的魔力晶核 (boss, upgrade of the starter crystal)
jobs.subject: a polished, multi-faceted blue mana crystal core held at the centre of a small gold ring engraved with tiny runes, like a quietly turning miniature magic circle, glowing softly. It should look like a grander, more refined version of the reference crystal.

jobs.name: water_sigil_relic
jobs.subject: a simple round amulet on a short cord: a silver disc engraved with the clean beginner lines of a water-droplet sigil, the lines glowing faint blue.

jobs.name: lesson_notebook
jobs.subject: a teacher's lesson-planning notebook, closed and stuffed with colourful sticky tabs and loose notes, a blue cover with a small star emblem, and a pencil tucked into the binding.

jobs.name: clear_water_pendant
jobs.subject: a teardrop-shaped glass pendant with a silver cap and loop, sealing a single perfectly clear drop of water that glows faintly from within.

jobs.name: milis_charm
jobs.subject: a modest travel charm from a holy church: a small shield-shaped talisman of wood and silver with a simple engraved holy cross-star symbol and a knotted blue cord. Plain but sturdy.
